run_optical_flow: run optical flow estimation on a directory of images using the RAFT model and save forward and backward flow fields
run_flow_with_frame_step: run optical flow computation on every Nth frame from an image directory using the --frame_step argument
warp_flow: warp an image using a given optical flow field with bilinear interpolation via cv2.remap
compute_fwdbwd_mask: compute forward and backward consistency masks from paired forward and backward optical flow fields using a threshold
summarize_run_flow: summarize the run_flow script which computes RAFT-based optical flow between consecutive frames and saves encoded flow PNGs and visualization JPGs
